assessments.topic: Exclusive paths, receipt gate and first-fault retention
assessments.evidence: The collector verifies the exact frozen manifest/payload/source/external identities and readiness disposition/true boolean/path/hash before original children. Actual destination is absent and exclusively created. Fixed eight pairs, unique scripts/logs/raw paths and no retries; failure stops subsequent children while preserving earlier and partial artifacts.
assessments.limits: Setup writes before the guarded run can leave a partial directory on filesystem failure. A row marked started or original_execution_attempted records an attempt, not proof of original export entry. Returned-Popen count does not prove no transient child on failed spawn. Per-child PID/UTC/elapsed records are absent; Root confirmed a separate outer invocation receipt will retain start/end/PID/exit. No frozen amendment was made.

assessments.evidence: The exact existing149608-byte xdev, five own source files and external image/libraries are pinned; lowercase import-trap declarations are distinguished from actual uppercase TRAP hits. assessments.limits: Fixed-time/RNG/libm/rune/C++/RTTI substitutes and discarded global atexit behavior are not actual Ableton host semantics. Historical source/binary identity does not automatically observe the target of every runtime binding; explicit Destroy is not a complete global cleanup guarantee.
